meta.name: nft-standards
meta.description: Implement NFT standards (ERC-721, ERC-1155) with proper metadata handling, minting strategies, and marketplace integration. Use when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发行 NFT 数字资产并接入交易市场
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在开发区块链上的 NFT 项目。
copy.tagline_en: Launch NFT digital assets and integrate with marketplaces.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building NFT projects on blockchain.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按 NFT 的 ERC-721/ERC-1155 标准生成合约代码,处理数量与价格限制、元数据(链上或 IPFS)与版税设置,并给出示例。
howto.when: 当要求创建 NFT 合约、构建 NFT 市场或实现数字资产系统等场景时会触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 ERC-721 合约,总量 10000,单价 0.08 ETH。
say.note: 会得到带总量和铸造价格的合约。

say.text: 写一个 ERC-1155 游戏物品合约,含剑、盾、药水三类代币。
say.note: 会得到支持批量铸造的多代币合约。

say.text: 给我的 NFT 加 EIP-2981 版税,费率 5%,收款人是部署者。
say.note: 合约会实现版税查询与费率设置。

howto.what_en: Claude generates Solidity contracts following ERC-721/ERC-1155, with minting logic for supply/price limits, IPFS or on-chain metadata, and EIP-2981 royalties.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating NFT contracts, building NFT marketplaces, or implementing digital asset systems.

say_en.text: Write an ERC-721 contract: max supply 10000, mint price 0.08 ETH.
say_en.note: Returns a contract with minting logic.

say_en.text: Create an ERC-1155 game-items contract for sword, shield, and potion tokens.
say_en.note: Produces a multi-token batch mint contract.

say_en.text: Add EIP-2981 royalties to my NFT: 5% fee, recipient is the deployer.
say_en.note: Contract includes royaltyInfo and fee settings.
